description: Start monitoring a website. Returns the site and the setup step the owner must complete before any monitor runs: connect the WordPress plugin, or verify the domain (the only option for non-WordPress sites). If the account already has a site on the same domain, that site is returned instead of a duplicate. How ownership is proven: https://www.relvato.com/docs/verify-site-ownership

platform.description: "wordpress" for WordPress/WooCommerce (deepest monitors via the Relvato plugin); "other" for any other site or AI-built app (public-page monitors, domain verification).
